exposure: method of impacted fetal head delivery
cohort: 105 women with singleton term pregnancies who underwent second-stage cesarean sections at the Pt. B.D. Sharma Post Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences, in Rohtak, Haryana, India, from October 2018 to December 2019.
finding: Second-stage cesarean section is technically challenging and usually accompanied by several maternal and neonatal risks, such as uterine incision extension, postpartum hemorrhage, blood transfusion, and NICU admissions.
